questions.solution_concept: Decomposing the softmax attention decay curve and using AST skeletonization to keep prompt size under 15k tokens where attention weight remains concentrated.

questions.title: How to calculate Shannon entropy on git staged diffs to prevent API key leaks in pre-commit hooks?

questions.solution_concept: Evaluating Shannon entropy density H(X) = -sum(P(x) * log2(P(x))) on git staged buffers, calibrated to H > 4.5 bits/char.

questions.title: How to stop TruffleHog / Gitleaks from flagging random UUIDs and commit SHAs as false positives?
